title: CIF Decision Analytics Suite
developer: Technique & software developed by Dr. Saeed Alinejad
description: Explore causal relationships, derive criterion weights and compare alternatives with circular intuitionistic fuzzy decision methods. Each method has its own Excel input, analysis workspace and downloadable results.

methods.name: CIF–DEMATEL
methods.description: Examine direct and total influences, identify prominent criteria and distinguish cause and effect groups.

methods.name: CIF–SWARA
methods.description: Aggregate expert evaluations and calculate normalized criterion weights with transparent intermediate results.

methods.name: CIF–WASPAS
methods.description: Evaluate alternatives through weighted-sum and weighted-product analysis with optimistic and pessimistic scenarios.
